subject: Consolidated bundle: Retain + Trace + Canvas dashboards — pilot & discount carveouts
messages:
From: Eliot Ramsey <eliot@opsdata.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Sofia Gutierrez <sofia@opsdata.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot pricing for telemetry bundle

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Canvas dashboards look promising for our SRE and product analytics teams. We spoke internally and would like to run a 6-week pilot that covers: 30-day trace retention for high-fidelity spans (prod services), prefix-preserving KV cache for 30M tokens/month of LLM inference, and access to two Canvas dashboards (SRE metrics + Customer Journeys).

Primary asks:
- Pilot discount: target 60% off list for the first 6 weeks (we'll commit to a short SOW if the results look good).
- Included support: one post-demo onboarding session + shared on-call for the pilot period.
- Clarify overage & egress: will trace retrieval egress/archival be billed separately?

I've attached a one-pager (OpsData_MA-plan_v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW (draft_sow_canvas_dashboard.pdf). Can you confirm a target price for the pilot and an estimate for run-rate if we convert to annual?

Sofia and I are available for a quick call Thursday morning PT.

Thanks,
Eliot
Eliot Ramsey
Director, Platform Engineering — OpsData
eliot@opsdata.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Ramsey <eliot@opsdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing for telemetry bundle

Eliot — appreciate the clear ask and the materials. Quick replies inline, plus a concrete pilot proposal below.

Short answers first:
- Pilot discount: we can support a timeboxed pilot at 55% off list for the bundle as structured below.
- Support: onboarding session + weekly office hours included.
- Egress & archival: trace retrieval for analysis within the pilot is included up to the pilot quota; long-term archival exports to S3 (if requested) are billed at standard egress rates and a small per-GB archival fee. We'll include the thresholds in the SOW.

Proposed 6-week pilot construct (concise):
- Bundle components: 30-day trace retention (prod services), Canvas dashboards (2 seats for dashboard editors, unlimited viewers), and LLM inference KV cache allowance equivalent to 30M tokens/month.
- Pilot price: $18k total for 6 weeks (reflects 55% discount off our hosted bundle list).
- Conversion path: if OpsData converts within 30 days of pilot end, we can credit 50% of pilot fees toward a 12-month committed package priced at our annual slab.
- Hard limits & overage: pilot caps will be set per the SOW. Overage rates for retention/egress are defined and we will surface telemetry early if you approach them.

Action items:
1) Ben — can you confirm whether we can stretch to 60% as a one-time concession if Eliot asks?
2) Kim — please prepare a draft SOW that includes the crediting language and the exact retention SLAs.
3) Eliot/Sofia — propose Thursday 10:00 PT or Friday 9:00 PT for a 30-min kickoff call.

Thanks — happy to be flexible here to get the pilot moving.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing for telemetry bundle — internal pricing note

Grace / Kim / Connor — quick internal note before the kickoff with OpsData. I pushed back on 55% in my head; conceding 60% for a 6-week pilot is steep but might be palatable if we: (a) make the conversion credit non-stackable and (b) cap the number of premium spans included. Proposed changes below that I'd like to confirm.

Ben's proposed pilot tweak (internal):
- Pilot concession: offer 60% off list but only if OpsData signs a two-paragraph commitment in the SOW acknowledging they will not engage in parallel pilots with two other vendors and that they will respond to two evaluation checkpoints.
- Premium spans cap: limit the included high-fidelity spans to 1M spans total for the 6-week period; additional spans billed at a higher overage tier (we can model marginal pricing).
- Canvas dashboard seats: provide 2 editor seats + up to 8 viewer seats; additional editors at standard seat price.
- Crediting: pilot fees credited up to 50% against a 12-month conversion, but credit only applies to bundle base (not egress/archival charges).

Connor — can you run the margin impact quickly (assume average token cost X, retention storage Y) and confirm this isn't a write-down? Kim, draft the SOW language Ben suggested around the non-compete pilot clause and the checkpoint obligations.

I think this structure gives us room to accept the pilot ask without cutting present value for the full-term deal. Will join the call later if needed.

-Ben
Senior Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Eliot Ramsey <eliot@opsdata.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Gutierrez <sofia@opsdata.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing for telemetry bundle

Grace / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposed structure. We reviewed Ben's tweaks internally and are generally comfortable with the trade-offs you outlined. A few clarifying points before we sign the SOW: 

1) Span definition: please confirm how you define a "premium span" for the cap calculation (is it sampled spans with full payload + trace context?).
2) Data residency: we need confirmation that SRE logs used to enrich traces during the pilot will not leave our us-east-1 tenancy for any archival exports.
3) Conversion timing: if we convert at pilot end, what is the earliest start date for the annual contract? Can we align invoice timing to our fiscal quarter close (Nov 30)?

Assuming we get clarity on #1 and #2, OpsData is OK to accept the 60% pilot concession with the checkpoint obligations. Please send the SOW with the non-compete pilot clause and the crediting language. We'll route DocuSign on our side and target Nov 1 as a go/no-go checkpoint.

Thanks — attaching a short internal decision memo (OpsData_MA-plan_v2.xlsx) for your reference.

Best,
Eliot
Director, Platform Engineering — OpsData
